name: Path of the Wild Heart (Barbarian Subclass - 2024)
description: Path of the Wild Heart Barbarians draw on animal-themed abilities, choosing different aspects to customize their rage and other features.

3.name: Animal Speaker
3.description: You can cast the Speak with Animals spell.

3.name: Rage of the Wilds
3.description: When you Rage, you choose one of the following animal aspects to gain its benefits: Bear (resistance to most damage types except psychic), Eagle (Dash as a bonus action, opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage), or Wolf (allies have advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature within 5 feet of you that is hostile to you).

6.name: Aspect of the Wilds
6.description: When you finish a Long Rest, choose one of the following animal aspects to gain its benefits until your next Long Rest: Owl (Darkvision 120ft, advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on sight in dim light/darkness), Panther (gain a climbing speed equal to your walking speed, and you can make a running long jump or a running high jump after moving only 5 feet on foot), or Salmon (gain a swimming speed equal to your walking speed, and you can breathe underwater).

10.name: Nature Speaker
10.description: You can cast the Commune with Nature spell as a ritual.

14.name: Power of the Wilds
14.description: When you Rage, you choose one of the following animal aspects (can be different from Rage of the Wilds choice): Falcon (gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed), Lion (as a bonus action, you can let out a menacing roar; each creature of your choice within 30 feet that can hear you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 + prof bonus + Cha mod) or become frightened of you for 1 minute; affected creatures can repeat save at end of each of their turns), or Ram (when you hit a Large or smaller creature with a melee weapon attack, you can knock it prone if it fails a Strength saving throw (DC 8 + prof bonus + Str mod)).
